source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.5, printed page 92 (PDF 95).

blocks.text: Woh compounds jin mein hydroxyl group kisi arene (aromatic ring) se jura ho, phenols kehlate hain. Sab se simple (saada) phenol ka formula C₆H₅OH hai. Phenol ko carbolic acid bhi kehte hain aur yeh carbolic soap (sabun) mein use hota tha. Phenol white (safaid) crystalline solid hai. Phenols ki kuch misalein neeche hain:

blocks.alt: Teen structures: phenol, OH wala benzene ring; 2-naphthol, do jure rings, position 2 par OH; 1-naphthol, do jure rings, position 1 par OH.
blocks.caption: Phenols ki misalein: phenol, 2-naphthol aur 1-naphthol (kitab ke PDF page 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno mein -OH seedha aromatic ring ke carbon par hai. Phenol mein ek benzene ring hai; 1-naphthol aur 2-naphthol mein do jure hue rings (naphthalene) hain, aur -OH position 1 ya 2 par hai.
Phenol phenylamine aur nitrous acid (HNO₂) ke reaction se banaya ja sakta hai. Yeh nitrous acid in situ (wahin isi bartan mein) banaya jata hai. Reaction teen steps mein hota hai.

items: Step 1 - HNO₂ itna unstable (jaldi toot jane wala) hai ke isay test-tube mein sodium nitrite (NaNO₂) aur dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl) se banaya jata hai, aur ice (barf) se temperature 10°C se neeche rakha jata hai.
Step 2 - Phir phenylamine HNO₂ se react kar ke ek unstable diazonium salt (benzenediazonium chloride, C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻) banata hai.
Step 3 - Aur garam (warm) karne par diazonium salt paani se toot jata hai (hydrolysis) aur phenol banta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wala benzene ring), arrow ke oopar NaNO2 aur neeche 'HCl, < 10 degree C', se benzenediazonium chloride (ring par N+ triple bond N aur Cl-), jo arrow ke oopar H2O aur neeche 'warm' (halka garam) ke saath phenol + N2 + HCl deta hai.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine se phenol ki preparation (kitab ke PDF page 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing; aakhri step sahi kiya gaya).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (22.5, PDF page 95) aakhri step ke arrow par NaOH likh kar phenol + NaCl + N₂ deti hai. Yeh sahi tareeqa nahi: phenol diazonium salt ke solution ko paani ke saath garam karne se banta hai, C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl, jaisa upar ki drawing mein bana hai aur jaisa kitab khud Chapter 24 (PDF page 125) mein likhti hai. Alkali (NaOH) mein phenol phenoxide ban jata aur bache hue diazonium ions se jur (couple ho) kar azo dye bana deta.

blocks.prompt: Diazonium salt 10°C se neeche kyun banaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh unstable hai; is temperature se oopar yeh use hone se pehle hi nitrogen gas chhor kar toot jata hai (aur nitrous acid bhi toot jata hai).

items: Phenols: -OH seedha arene (aromatic ring) par; misalein phenol, 1-naphthol, 2-naphthol.
Phenylamine + HNO₂ (NaNO₂ + HCl, 10°C se neeche) se diazonium salt; paani ke saath garam karne par phenol + N₂.
